final: WITH d AS (SELECT ma.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member m JOIN major ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY ma.department), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM d), dj AS (SELECT d.department, d.cnt, CAST(d.cnt AS REAL) / s.total AS share FROM d JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM dj) SELECT dj.department, dj.cnt, dj.share, dj.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM dj JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE dj.share > a.avg_share
